reason: Alert 1 (xss) is TP. User input from request.getHeader('Referer') flows to response.getWriter().println(bar) without HTML encoding. Although doSomething() modifies the last character to 'Z', this does not neutralize XSS payloads (e.g., '<script>' tags remain intact). The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input.

evidence.note: Input from getHeader('Referer') assigned to param, decoded, passed to doSomething, then printed to response writer.
doSomething modifies last char to 'Z' but preserves preceding HTML/script content, failing to mitigate XSS.
